thread:
ash: Quick RFC follow-up: proposal for a lightweight API gateway shim that translates legacy POST /v1/complete (single-turn text completion) into the newer /v2/chat/completions shape. Goal: let us deprecate /v1 cleanly while minimizing customer breakage.
ben: Outline please. what are the tricky bits?
ash: Main transforms: wrap incoming prompt into messages [{role: \"user\", content: prompt}], map top-level params (temperature, max_tokens) to v2 fields, translate legacy `stop` arrays into v2 stop or function-calling hints, and map model aliases. Also we need to handle non-streaming -> streaming conversions and vice-versa.
carmen: streaming conversion is the hairy part. Old clients expect a single long response body; new runtime streams SSE fragments. Shim must either buffer streaming output into one body or reframe SSE into legacy chunking for those tenants. Buffering increases latency; reframing requires stream-to-chunk translator.
wei: Infrastructure preference: put shim in a pool of language-gateway sidecars so we can scale independently. Sidecars can run a small Rust binary that performs the mapping and has low memory. Route opt-in tenants via header `X-Compat: legacy-complete` first.
nina: ML note: be careful with system prompts. v1 customers sometimes included instructions inline; our chat models treat system messages specially. Default behavior: put top-of-prompt content into the first user message and do NOT add a system message unless customer explicitly provided `system_prompt` param. We'll document the semantic difference.
ash: telemetry: emit `compat:legacy-complete.applied` event with tags: model_alias, streaming_conversion, mapping_errors. Also track latency percentiles pre/post-shim.
ben: failure modes to track: unknown-alias, stop-conflict (stop token ambiguous), function-call-intent-detected (older clients send special markers), framing-error. Add a spike alert if mapping_error rate > 0.5% per minute.
carmen: cache normalization: legacy V1 used prompt-hash keys; v2 uses conversation-key + last-tokens. Shim must normalize keys to v2 scheme to avoid cache duplication. That implies computing the v2 cache key server-side. We'll need access to hashing util library.
wei: ops checklist: sidecar autoscale policy, canary rollout (0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%), health endpoint that validates mapping by replaying small test prompts, include a `X-Deprecated-Version: v1` response header and `Deprecation-Warning: v1 removed in 90d; sample=0.02`.
nina: QA: prepare 30 canonical prompts including edge cases: stop sequences, long context, function-call markers, multilingual text. Run regression of outputs (similarity threshold) and validate behavior of system-prompt handling.
ben: compatibility mode knob: we should support 3 modes via header or tenant flag: `strict` (reject any ambiguous mapping), `lenient` (try best-effort), and `buffered` (buffer streaming into single response). Default opt-in should be `lenient`.
nash: example transform docs snippet:
```
// legacy v1
POST /v1/complete
{ "model": "gen-legacy-1", "prompt": "Summarize product updates.", "stop": ["\n--"], "stream": false }
\n// shim -> v2
POST /v2/chat/completions
{ "model": "gen-2026", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize product updates."}], "stop": ["\n--"], "stream": false }
```
ben: devDX: provide a tiny npm/py helper that adds the `X-Compat` header and a local shim binary so customers can test. Also add a curl example in the migration guide.
wei: security: ensure auth headers and client certificate passthrough are preserved; shim must not log secrets. Add request/response redaction in logs.
carmen: performance: Rust sidecar can handle stream reframing with bounded buffer; p50 extra latency projected ~0.8ms, p95 ~3ms when reframing enabled. Buffering mode p50 +30ms.
nina: ops-bot note: deploy-preview: compat-sidecar v0.1 created on canary cluster (id: compat-bridge-a1). Monitoring dashboards spun up. :rocket:
ben: next steps: ash to draft RFC addendum with alias map and sample prompts, wei to provision canary, carmen to prototype rust reframer, nina to prepare eval set, I'll draft migration docs and comms.
ash: thanks all. I'll open follow-ups and label owners. :thumbsup:
